summary: Frontend-only verification of the new SocialProfile (Profile page) enhancements in Creator lane. All 5 sections (Identity, Stats Dashboard, Battle Status, Personal Playlists, My Raps) render correctly with the expected data-testids. Battle aggregation works (rapper_alpha shows lifetime_wins=1, history row with W badge). Register CTA, Queue card, Playlists Manage navigation, and Battle Status navigation to Connect all wired correctly via onNavigate. Active-battle card path verified by code review (state branch with matching opponent profile name + onNavigate('connect')).

issues: React console warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key f6bf37ecb304a4' fires on every page load — duplicate key in a list render (not in SocialProfile, but visible across navigations). Non-blocking but worth tracking.

test_results_detail.profile_playlists_empty_and_manage: PASS (empty state for rapper_alpha; Manage -> opens 'My Playlists' view with seeded John/Kyle playlists)

action_items: (Low priority) Investigate React duplicate key warning 'f6bf37ecb304a4' that fires across page navigations — not from SocialProfile but visible in console during profile testing.
(Optional) Consider also exposing total likes/views from a server-side aggregation; current stat-likes/stat-views derive from kept-recordings sum which is 0 for new users until they keep recordings.
critical_code_review_comments: SocialProfile.js (588 lines) is approaching the 700-line guideline. Sub-components BattleStatusSection / PlaylistsSection / MyRapsSection are already in-file; consider extracting into /pages/profile/ sub-files if more sections are added.

loadProfileExtras() catches all errors and only console.errors. Consider surfacing a soft retry or 'Couldn’t load stats' inline hint so a partial failure (e.g. playlists 5xx) doesn’t silently show empty states.

In BattleStatusSection the opponent is computed via active.user_a === snapshot.user?.user_id ? active.profile_b : active.profile_a. If profile_a/profile_b is ever null (e.g. backend race), this throws. Recommend optional-chaining .display_name and a fallback string.
MyRapsSection key uses r.id — fine, but make sure backend never returns duplicate ids; the duplicate-key React warning seen in console suggests a list elsewhere has dup ids.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (8/8 testable flows; 1 flow verified via code review)

context_for_next_testing_agent: SocialProfile.js (Creator-lane Profile) now ships 5 sections with data-testids: profile-username/edit/name-input/save-btn, stat-wins/losses/likes/views, profile-battle-status with profile-register-cta | profile-queue-card | profile-active-battle, profile-battle-history with battle-history-{id} rows (W/L/T badges), profile-playlists (with profile-playlists-empty | profile-playlists-row + profile-playlists-manage), profile-my-raps (with profile-my-raps-empty | profile-my-raps-list + profile-rap-{id} / profile-rap-play-{id} / profile-rap-likes-{id} / profile-rap-views-{id}). user_id comes from localStorage.sidetrack_voter_id, display name from sidetrack_username. To exercise queue state quickly: curl -X POST /api/rap-battles/register with a fresh user_id then set the same id in localStorage. The active-battle card was not exercised live; pair two queued users (POST /register twice) to test it.
